name: Nextly Self-Hosted CMS
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted content management and visual page builder for Next.js with schema editing, localization, version history, roles and publishing workflows; no vendor-imposed software quota or expiry published.
watch_out: Alpha software: APIs may change before 1.0; pin versions and test before production. Requires your own Next.js hosting, database (PostgreSQL/MySQL or local SQLite), storage and operational security. External storage, hosting and third-party integrations may incur charges; no free hosted resources are included.
